fixes.explanation: Right there. Paul says, "I am standing before the judgment seat of Caesar, where I ought to be tried." (Acts 25:10) He also adds that he has done nothing wrong to the Jews, as Festus himself knows very well. Paul isn't asking for a favor here. He's saying where the trial belongs.

True. Paul says, "If, however, I am guilty of anything worthy of death, I do not refuse to die." (Acts 25:11) He isn't dodging punishment if he's guilty. He goes on to say that if there is no truth to their accusations, no one has the right to hand him over to them.
